statusText: Mapped policy state: ON. NQ remains inside the repaired session range; no renewed failed-retracement sequence is verified. External macro and geopolitical conditions keep Stress extreme.
recommendation: Current Tail is 18%. Mapped policy state: EA_ON. G.19 Consumer Credit at 19:00 UTC is a scheduled WATCH checkpoint.
headline: Tail remains low as NQ holds inside the repaired range amid split technology leadership
body: A delayed NQ quote showed 29,559.25 inside a 29,477.75–29,739.00 range, about 82 points above the low. Reuters reported a nearly flat Nasdaq Composite, while fresh supplementary evidence showed strong semiconductors but split megacaps.

lookbackSummary: Across the preceding 24 UTC clock-hour slots, published ChatGPT Tail ranged from 17% to 32% and Stress from 92% to 100%. The 14:00 UTC cash-open slot reached 32% on downside extension, then Tail fell to 23% and 18% as meaningful repair developed.
outlookSummary: Current Tail remains low while NQ holds inside a repaired, two-sided range. Consumer Credit at 19:00 UTC is the next WATCH checkpoint. Overnight Tail stays low under orderly rotation; tomorrow’s Employer Costs release raises Stress, while higher Tail still requires observed persistent repricing.
